description: A clear Penn tennis-ball canister sits on a table, with its red plastic lid and several yellow tennis balls nearby. The left hand holds the canister steady as the right hand pulls the red lid up and off, tilts the canister sideways, and removes tennis balls one by one; after the balls are out, the right hand brings the red lid back over the opening and presses it down to close while the left hand continues supporting the canister as a two-hand object.
